0|ffb9eb3d8b450c22bbbc688c6b630141ac476fd9|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"nl80211: add power save commands
The most needed command from nl80211
is support for power save mode. Add a simple command to make it possible
to enable and disable power save via nl80211.
I was also planning about extending the interface
timeout value
column2: but after thinking more about this I decided not to do it.

column1: Basically there were three reasons:
Firstly
column2: the parameters for power save are very much hardware dependent.

column1: Trying to find a unified interface which would work with all hardware
still make sense to users
Secondly
column2: IEEE 802.11 power save implementation in Linux is still in state

column1: of flux. We have a long way to still to go and there is no way to predict
what kind of implementation we will have after few years. And because we
need to support nl80211 interface a long time
now parameters to nl80211 might create maintenance problems later on.
Third issue are the users. Power save parameters are mostly used for
debugging
For example
column2: wpa_supplicant currently doesn't configure anything related

column1: to power save mode. It's better to strive that kernel can automatically
optimise the power save parameters
column2: like with help of pm qos network

column1: and other traffic parameters.
Later on
column2: when we have better understanding of power save

column1: this command with more features
column2: if there's a need for that.
